description:
Export a revision to a final deliverable — `format` picks it: `pdf` (print PDF), `png`/`jpeg`/`webp` (image), `svg` (vector SVG), `pdfx` (print-ready PDF/X), `html` (responsive HTML5), `mp4` (video), `imgly` (editable design file). Renders `blockId` — or the whole document when `blockId` is omitted — and writes the result into the workspace under `exports/<shard>/<rev>/` (revision-pinned, deterministic).

Returns JSON: `{ uri, httpUrl, bytes, format, revision }` (plus `path` when you pass `outPath`). `uri` (a `workspace://` URI) is the durable handle. `httpUrl` is a fetch link tied to this process — fetch it to download the bytes to disk, or hand it to the user.

`outPath` (optional, absolute path including the filename): ALSO write the artifact to that local path — the workspace copy is still written, and the response then carries `path`. Use it when the file is wanted on disk, and always when your environment cannot fetch localhost URLs (sandboxed harnesses, e.g. Claude Cowork — target your session's outputs folder there).

`format=svg` is the engine's vector export: text is outlined into paths (renders identically everywhere, but is not editable text in the SVG), and raster images are embedded in the file at source resolution — an SVG of a photo-heavy design can be much larger than its source images.

`format=imgly` writes a portable, self-contained `.imgly` design file (scene + all asset bytes bundled) — the inverse of `import`, and the only format that stays editable. Whole-design only: `blockId` is not accepted. Every `edit` already auto-persists to the workspace, so you never need this to keep your work — use it to take an editable copy OUT: hand it to a human, back it up, move it between servers.

`format=pdfx` runs the print PDF through a PDF/X conversion (Ghostscript): CMYK with an embedded ICC profile and PDF/X conformance markers, ready for a print shop. Tune it via the optional `pdfx` object — conformance standard (X-4 default / X-3), output profile (fogra39/gracol/srgb/custom), transparency flattening, OutputIntent metadata. Conversion adds a few seconds.

`format=html` renders ONE page (`blockId` required — pass a page id) to responsive HTML5. Default is a single self-contained `.html` (assets inlined; animated designs get a CDN GSAP player injected so the file plays as-is); `html: { assets: "external" }` delivers html + separate image/font files as one `.zip`.

`format=mp4` renders the authored timeline of the block (typically a page) to an H.264 `mp4`; duration and resolution come from the scene; frame rate is `fps` (default 30). Requires the native engine (the default). Long encodes report MCP progress notifications when the client sends a progressToken.

blockId.description: The page or block to render. Omit to export the whole document — for `format=pdf` a multi-page PDF, for an image format one composite image of all pages. Required for format=html (pass a page id). Required for `format=mp4` (pass a page id).

format.description: The deliverable: pdf → print PDF; png/jpeg/webp → image; svg → vector SVG; pdfx → print-ready PDF/X; html → HTML5 page; mp4 → video; imgly → editable design file.

fps.description: Frames per second for `format=mp4` only (invalid with any other format). Default 30. Common values: 24, 25, 30, 60.

html.description: Options for `format=html` only (invalid with any other format).

assets.description: embedded (default): one self-contained .html, assets inlined as data URLs — viewable anywhere as-is. external: html + separate image/font files, delivered as one .zip.

outPath.description: Absolute path (including filename) to ALSO write the artifact to — the workspace copy is still written, and the response then carries `path`. Use when you need the file on disk and cannot fetch localhost URLs (sandboxed harnesses).

pdfx.description: Options for `format=pdfx` only (invalid with any other format). Omit entirely for sensible print defaults: PDF/X-4, fogra39, embedded ICC.

embedICCProfile.description: Default true. false → plain CMYK (or RGB) PDF with no embedded ICC profile, OutputIntent, or PDF/X markers — for prepress pipelines that apply their own profile.

flattenTransparency.description: PDF/X-3 only (default true there): rasterize transparent content for strict compliance. false keeps transparency live — better fidelity, may not validate. Ignored on PDF/X-4.

outputCondition.description: Overrides /OutputCondition — the human-readable printing-condition description (e.g. "ISO Coated v2 (ECI)"). Defaults from outputProfile.

outputConditionIdentifier.description: Overrides the PDF's /OutputConditionIdentifier — the REGISTERED printing-condition name preflight tools and print shops check (e.g. "FOGRA39", "CGATS 21.2"). Defaults from outputProfile; with a custom profile, your print shop tells you what to put here.

outputProfile.description: Target printing condition / ICC output profile. fogra39 (default) = ISO Coated v2 (ECI), European offset. gracol = GRACoL 2013 CRPC6, US commercial. srgb = keep RGB, for digital distribution. custom = supply the print shop's ICC file via profileUri.

outputStandard.description: PDF/X conformance target. PDF/X-4 (default) keeps live transparency. PDF/X-3 is the older PDF 1.4 standard — it flattens transparency by default and can rasterize gradients/alpha content.

profileUri.description: Required with outputProfile="custom" (invalid otherwise): an https:// URL or absolute local file path of the .icc profile to embed.

title.description: PDF document title. Defaults to the design's title.

name: export
